m: दशा (आस्) f. pl. ‘Decads’, N. of 10 Jain texts (उपासक-. &c.) consisting of 10 chs. each.
दशा f. (√ दंश्?) the fringe of a garment, loose ends of any piece of cloth, skirt or hem, KātyŚr. iv, 1, 17 (ऊर्णा), Lāṭy. viii, 6, 22; Kauś.; ŚāṅkhGṛ. ii, 12, 5; Mn. &c.
a wick, Gobh. iv, 2, 32 (क्षौम-), Kum. iv, 30; Bhartṛ. iii, i
state or condition of life, period of life (youth, manhood, &c.), condition, circumstances, R.; Pañcat.; Megh. &c.
the fate of men as depending on the position of the planets, aspect or position of the planets (at birth &c.), VarBṛS.; VarBṛ.; Laghuj.
the mind, L.

a: दशा — 1 The threads at the end of a piece of woven cloth, the fringe of a garment, the skirt, edge or hem of a garment; रक्तांशुकं पवनलोलदशं वहंती Mk. 1. 20; छिन्ना इवांबरपटस्य दशाः पतंति 5. 4. --2 The wick of a lamp; Bh. 3. 129; Ku. 4. 30. --3 Age or time of life; see दशांत below. --4 A period or stage of life; as बाल्य, यौवन, &c.; R. 5. 40. --5 A period in general. --6 State, condition, circumstances; नीचैर्गच्छत्युपरि च दशा चक्रनामंक्रंमंण Me. 109; विषमां हि दशां प्राप्य दैवं गर्हयते नरः H. 4. 3. --7 State or condition of mind. --8 The result of actions, fate. --9 The aspect or position of planets (at birth). --10 The mind, understanding. --Comp. --अधिपतिः, --ईशः the sun; (for other meanings see under दशन्). --अंतः {1} the end of a wick. {2} the end of life; निर्विष्टविषयस्नेहः स दशांतमुपेयिवान् R. 12. 1 (where the word is used in both senses). --अंतरं different states, vicissitudes of life; Ś. 4. 1. --अंतरः a lamp. --कर्षः, --कर्षिन् m. {1} the end of a garment. {2} a lamp. --पाकः, --विपाकः {1} the fulfilment of fate. {2} a changed condition of life. --विपर्यासः ill-luck, misfortune.

k.v: स्त्रियां बहुत्वे वस्त्रस्य दशाः स्युर्वस्तयोर्द्वयोः। दैर्घ्यमायाम आरोहः परिणाहो विशालता॥

। skanda uvAca । mitrAvaruRayoH putra । mahimAnaM bravImi te । kASyAM daSASvameDasya sarvatIrTaSiromaReH । daSASvameDikaM prApya sarvatIrTottamottamam । yat kiYcit kriyate karma tadakzayamiheritam । snAnaM dAnaM tapo homaH svADyAyo devatArcanam । sanDyopAstistarpaRaYca SrAdDaM pitfsamarccanam । daSASvameDike tIrTe sakft snAtvA narottamaH । dfzwvA daSASvameDeSaM sarvapApEH pramucyate । jyEzWe mAsi site pakze prApya pratipadaM tiTim । daSASvameDike snAtvA muvyate janmapAtakAt । jyEzWaSukladvitIyAyAM snAtvA rudrasarovare । janmadvayakftaM pApaM tatkzaRAdeva muYcati । evaM sarvAsu tiTizu kramAt snAyAnnarottamaH । A SukladaSamIM yAvaddaSajanmAGamutsfjet । tiTiM daSaharAM prApya daSajanmAGahAriRIm । daSAScameDike snAtIyAmIM paSyenna yAtanAm । liNgaM daSASvameDeSaM dfzwvA daSaharAtiTO । daSajanmArjitEH pApEstyajyate nAtra saMSayaH । snAto daSahArAyAM yaH pUjayelliNgasuttamam । BaktyA daSASvameDeSaM na ta garBadaSA spfSet । jyEzWe mAsi site pakze pakzaM rudrasare naraH । kurvanvE vArzikIM yAtrAM na viGnEraBiBUyate । daSASvameDAvaBfTEryat PalaM samyagApyate । daSASvameDe tannUnaM snAtvA daSaharAtiTO । svardDunyAH paScime tIre natvA daSahareSvaram । na durddaSAmavApnoti pumAn puRyatamaH kvacit । yat kASyAM dakziRadvAramantargehasya kIrttyate । tatra brahmeSvaraM dfzwvA brahmaloke mahIyate । iti brAhmaRaveSena vArARasyAM mahADiyA । druhiRena sTitaM tAvadyAvadviSverAgamaH । divodAsI'pi rAjendro vfdDabrAhmaRarUpiRe । brahmaRe kftayajYAya brahmaSAlAmakArayat । brahemSvara samIpe tu brahmaSAlA manoharA । brahmA tatrAvasadDyoma brahmaTIzErninAdayan .”

s: puM, (daSa fRAni durgaBUmayo jalADArA vA yatra । “etyeDatyUwsu .” 8 । 4 । 65 । ityasya “pravatsatarakambalavasanArRadaSAnAmfRe .” iti vArttikoktyA vfdDiH .) deSaviSezaH । sa binDyaparvvatasya pUrvvadakziRasyAM diSi varttate । (yaTA, bfhatsaMhitAyAm । 14 । 10 । “kizkinDakaRwakasTalanizAdarAzwrARi purikadaSArRAH ॥” tadasyABijanaH tasya rAjA vA aR । taddeSavAsini tannfpatO ca tri । yaTA, mahABArate । 1 । 113 । 25 । “pUrvvamAgaskfto gatvA daSArRAH samare jitAH । pARqunA nArasiMhena kOravARAM yaSomftA ॥” daSa arRAni varRAni yatra । daSAkzaramatnaviSezaH । yaTA, gotamIyatantre । 2 aDyAye । “daSAnAmapi tattvAnAM sAkzI vettA taTAkzaram । daSAkzara iti KyAto mantrarAjaH parAtparaH ॥ luptabIjasvaBAvatvAt daSArRa iti kaTyate ॥”) nadIviSeze, strI । iti SabdArTakalpataruH ॥
v: pu॰ daSa fRAni dugsaMRi BUmayo jalADArA vA yatra “pravatsetyAdinA” pA॰ vfdDiH । 1 deSaBede sa ca deSaH vf॰ saM॰ kUrmmaviBAge 14 a॰ AgneyyAmukto yaTA “AgneyyAM diSi kosalAH” ityupakrame “nizAdarAzwrARi purikadASArRAH” । svArTe aR । “tulADare'vantyaparAntya sADUn baRigdaSArRAn BarukacCapAMSca” 5 a॰ । “saptavyADA daSArRezu” SrAdDe pAWyapitfgATA । tadvAvakaSabdo yatrAnuvAke'DyAye asti vimuktA॰ aR । dASArRa daSArRaSabdayukte anuvAke aDyAye ca । so'Bijano'sya tasya rAjA vA aR । dASArRa pitrAdikrameRa taddeSavAsini tannfpe ca “tatra dASArRako rAjA suDarmmA lomaharzaRam । kftavAn BImasenena mahadyudDaMnirAyuDam” BA॰ sa॰ 28 a॰ । BImaprAcIjaye । atra svArTe ka । bahuzu aRo luk । “pUrvamAgaskfto jitvA daSArRAH samare jitAH” BA॰ A॰ 113 a॰ । “vijityAlpena kAlena daSArRAnajayat praBuH । pratIcIsTo'pi tannAmA deSo'sti “tAn daSArRAn sa jitvA ca pratasTe pARqunandanaH” BAM॰ sa॰ 31 a॰ । nakulapratIcIjaye । ataeva BA॰ BI॰ 9 a॰ “ataUrdDaM janapadAnniboDa gadatomama” ityu pakrame “uttamASca daSArRASca mekalAScotkalEH saha” ityatra uttamatvena pUrvaM pUrvadakziRasyAm daSArRAnuktvA “jaWarAH kukkurAScEva sadaSArRASca BArata! । punaranyo nirviSezaRo daSArRadeSa uktaH । parastAcca “vAtAyanA daSArRASca romARaH kuSavindavaH ityatra vAtAyanatvenaviSezaRAt tAdfSo'pi deSaBedo'stIti gamyate । “sampatsyante katipayadinasTyAyi haMsA daSArRAH” meGa॰ ।
m: दशार्ण mfn. having 10 syllables, VS. iii, 41, Sch.
दशार्ण m. pl. (g. विमुक्तादि) ‘Ten Lakes’, N. of a people (south-east of Madhya-deśa, VarBṛS.), MBh.; Hariv.; R.; Megh.
दशार्ण m. sg. a Daśārṇa king, MBh. v, 7519
दशार्ण n. the Daśārṇa country, Pāṇ. vi, 1, 89, Vārtt. 8, Pat. (दश + ऋण)
a: दशार्ण — N. of a country, through which flows the Daśārṇā (Dasan). It was the eastern part of Mālava or Mālvā, its capital being Vidiśā--the modern Bhilsā--situated on the Vetravatī or Betva, cf. Me. 24, 25 and Kādambarī. Kālidāsa also makes Vidiśā a river which is probably the same as the Bees that joins the Betva.

s: puM, (daSa avatArA yasya .) vizRuH । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ tasya daSAvatArA yaTA, -- matsyaH 1 kUrmmaH 2 varAhaH 3 nfsiMhaH 4 vAmanaH 5 jAmadagnyaH 6 rAmaH 7 kfzRaH 8 budDaH 9 kalkI 10 । iti varAhapurARam ॥ api ca । “DarmmAnnArAyaRasyAMSaH saMBUtaScAkzuze'ntare । yajYaYca varttayAmAsurdevA vEvasvate'ntare ॥ prAdurBAve tatastasya brahmA hyAsIt purohitaH । yugAKyAyAYca turyyAntu Apannezu surezu vE ॥ saMBUtaH sa samudrAnte hiraRyakaSiporvaDe । dvitIye narasiMhAKye rudro hyAsIt purohitaH ॥ balisaMsTezu lokezu tretAyAM saptamaM prati । tftIye vAmanasyArTe GarmmeRa tu puroDasA ॥ etAstisraH smftAstasya divyAH saMBUtayo dvijAH । mAnuzyAH sapta ye'nye tu SApajAstAnniboData ॥ tretAyuge tu praTame dattAtreyo baBUva ha । nazwe Darmme caturTAMSe mArkaRqeyapuraHsaraH ॥ paYcamaH paYcadaSyAntu tretAyAM sambaBUva ha । mAnDAtA cakravarttI tu tasyOtaTyaH puraHsaraH ॥ ekonaviMSyAM tretAyAM sarvvakzattrAntakfdviBuH । jAmadagnyastaTA zazWo viSvAmitrapuraHsaraH ॥ caturvviMSe yuge rAmo vaSizWena puroDasA । saptamo rAvaRasyArTe jajYe daSaraTAtmajaH ॥ azwame dbApare vizRurazwAviMSe parASarAt । vedavyAsastaTA jajYe jAtUkarRapuraHsaraH ॥ karttuM DarmmavyavasTAnamasurARAM praRASanam । budDo navamake jajYe tapasA puzkarekzaRaH ॥ devakyAM vasudevena dbEpAyanapuraHsaraH । tasminneva yuge kzIRe sanDyASizwe Bavizyati ॥ kalkI vizRuyaSA nAma pArASaryyapuraHsaraH । daSamo BAvyasaMBUto yAjYavalkyapurasaraH ॥” iti matsyapurARam ॥
v: pu॰ daSa avatArA asya । vizRO daSa avatArASca avatAraSabde dfSyA anye'pi daSAvatArAH matsyapu॰ uktA yaTA “DarmAnnArAyaRasyAMSaH saMmUtaScAkzuze'ntare । yajYaYca varttayAmAsurdevA vEvasvate'ntare । prAdurBAve tatastasya brahmA hyAsIt purohitaH । yugAKyAyAYcaturTyAntu Apannezu surezu vE । saMBUtaH sa samudrAnte hiraRyakaSiporbaDe । dvitIye narasiMhAKye rudro hyAsIt purohitaH । valisaMsTezu lokezu tretAyAM saptamaM prati । tftIye vAmanasyArTe DarmeRa tu puroDasA । etAstisraH smftAstasya divyAH saMBUtayo dvijAH । mAnuzyAH sapta ye'nye tu SApajAstAnniboData । tretAyuge tu praTame dattAtreyo baBUva ha । nazwe Darme caturTAMSe mArkaRqeyapuraHsaraH । paYcamaH paYcadaSyAntu tretAyAM sambaBUva ha । mAnDAtA cakravarttI tu tasyOtaTyapuraHsaraH । ekonaviMSyAM tretAyAM sarvakzatrAntakfdviBuH । jAmadagnyastaTA zazWo viSvAmitra puraHsaraH । caturviMSe yuge rAmo vaSizWena puroDasA । saptamo rAvaRasyArTe jajYe daSaraTAtmajaH । azwame dvApare vizRurazwAviMSe parASarAt । vedavyAsastaTA jajYe jAtUkarRapuraHsaraH । karttuM DarmavyavasTAnamasurARAM praRASanam । tizye navamake jajYe tapasA puzkarekzaRaH । devakyAM vasudevena dvEpAyanapuraHsaraH । tasminneva yuge kzIRe sanDyASizwe Bavizyati । kalkI vizRuyaSA nAma pArASaryyapuraHsaraH । daSamo BAvyasaMBUto yAjYavalkyapuraHsaraH .”
m: दशावतार m. (= ˚श-रूप) Viṣṇu, L.

दशावतार—चरित n. N. of wk.
द˚शावयव m. N. of Śiva, L.

दशा-विपाक m. fulfilment of destiny, Mālatīm.

v: tri॰ ekAdaSArTatvAdekAdaSa vastato daSa ye dattA daSa ekAdaSa Bavizyanti te daSEkAdaSAH nipAtanAt samAsAnto'kAraH । “prayacCati garhyam” pA॰ daSEkAdaSAn prayacCatItyarTe “kusIdadaSEkAdaSAt zWanzWacA viti pA॰ zWac । SataM prati daSakarUpAM vfdDiM grahotari vArdDuzikaBede striyAM zittvAt NIz ।

‘Suklapakzasya daSamI jyEzWe mAsi dbijottama ! । harate daSa pApAni tasmAddaSaharA smftA ॥’ atra kevaladaSamyAM daSaviDapApakzayaH Palam । Bavizye । ‘jyEzWaSukladaSamyAntu hastayogena jAhnavI । harate daSa pApAni tasmAddaSaharocyate ॥’ daSapApAnIti daSajanmakftAnIti । viSezaRIyamAha parASaraBAzye yamaH । ‘jyEzWe mAsi site pakze daSamyAM hastayogataH । daSajanmAGahA gaNgA daSapApaharA smftA ॥’ atra martyalokam । pApAnyasyAM harati ca tiTO sA daSetyAhurAryyAH puRyaM dadyAdapi SataguRaM vAjimeDAyutasya ॥’ BOmavArahastAnakzatrayuktadaSamyAM gaNgAsnAnAddaSaviDapApakzayaSataguRavAjimeDAyutajanyapuRyasamapuRyaM Palam । rAjamArttaRqe vAlmIkiH । ‘adattAnAmupAdAnaM hiMsA cEvAviDAnataH । paradAropasevA ca kAyikaM triviDaM smftam ॥ BftyAnAYcEva vfttyarTamagastyo hyAcarat purA ॥’ yadyapi paruzavacanamapavAdaH pESunyamanftaM vfTAlApo nizWuravacanamiti vANmayAni zaw । parezAM deSajAtikulavidyASilparUpavfttyAcAraparicCadaSarIrakarmmajIvinAM pratyakzadozavacanaM paruzam । ‘yaccAnyat kroDasantApatrAsasaMjananaM vacaH । paruzaM tacca vijYeyaM yaccAnyacca taTAviDam ॥ cakzuzmanniti luptAkzaM caRqAlaM brAhmaReti ca । praSaMsAnindanaM dvezAt paruzAnna viSizyate ॥’ * ॥ tezAmeva paruzavacanAnAM parokzamudAharaRamapavAdaH ॥ * ॥ gurunfpatibanDuBrAtfmitrasakASe arTopaGAtArTaM dozopAKyAnaM pESunyam ॥ * ॥ anftaM dviviDaM asatyamasaMvAdaSceti ॥ * ॥ ‘deSarAzwraprasaNgAcca parArTaparikalpanAt । narmmahAsaprasaNgAcca BAzaRaM vyarTaBAzaRam ॥ * ॥ guhyANgAmeDyasaMjYAnAM vacanaM nizWuraM viduH । yadanyadbA vaco nIcaM strIpuMsormmiTunASrayam ॥ * ॥ ityevaM zaqvikalpasya duzwavAkyasya BAzaRAt । iha vAsutra vA krUramanarTaM pratipadyate ॥’ praSaMsayA nindanaM praSaMsAnindanam । taTApyatra caturvviDazaqviDayoraviroDaH । samakzatvAsamakzatvaBedAnAdareRa pAruzyApavAdayorEkyAt nizWurasya paruzAntarBAvAcca । asambadDapralApavyarTaBAzaRayoH paryyAyatvAt nArTAntaram । aBiDyAnamapaharaRArTamiti SezaH । vitaTe asatyaBUte vastuni aBiniveSaH punaH punaH saNkalpaH .” iti tiTyAditattvam ॥ * ॥ api ca । “aTa jyEzWaSukladaSamI daSaharA । taduktaM hemAdrO brAhme । “jyEzWe mAsi site pakze daSamI hastasaMyutA । harate daSa pApAni tasmAddaSaharA smfteti ॥ vArAhe'pi । ‘daSamI Suklapakze tu jyEzWe mAsi kuje'hani ॥ avatIrRA yataH svargAdDastarkze ca saridvarA ॥ harate daSa pApAni tasmAddaSaharA smfteti ॥ * ॥ skAnde tu daSayogA uktAH । yaTA, -- ‘jyEzWe mAsi site pakze daSamyAM buDahastayoH । vyatIpAte garAnande kanyAcandre vfze ravO ॥ daSayoge naraH snAtvA sarvvapApEH pramucyate ॥’ iti । atra buDaBOmayoH kalpamedena vyavasTA । iyaYca yatrEva yogabAhulyaM sEva grAhyA । yogADikye PalADikyAt ॥ * ॥ jyEzWe malamAse sati tatrEva daSaharA kAryyA na tu SudDe । ‘daSaharAsu notkarzaScaturzvapi yugAdizu .’ iti hemAdrO fzyaSfNgokteH ॥ * ॥ taTA skAnde । ‘yAM kAYcit saritaM prApya dadyAdarGyaM tilodakam । mucyate daSaBiH pApEH sa mahApAtakopamEH ॥’ atra viSezaH kASIKaRqe । ‘jyEzWe mAsi site pakze prApya pratipadaM tiTim । daSASvameDike snAtvA mucyate sarvvapAtakEH ॥ evaM sarvvAsu tiTizu kramasnAyI narottamaH । ASuklapakzadaSamIM pratijanmAGamutsfjet ॥’ taTA । ‘liNgaM daSASvameDeSaM dfzwvA daSaharAtiTO । daSajanmArjjitEH pApEstyajyate nAtra saMSayaH ॥’ taTA BavizyottarakASIKaRqayoH । ‘niSAyAM jAgaraM kftvA samupozya ca BaktitaH । puzpErganDESca nEvedyEH PalESca daSasaNKyayA ॥ taTA dIpESca tAmbUlEH pUjayet SradDayAnvitaH । snAtvA BaktyA tu jAhnavyAM daSakftvo viDAnataH ॥ daSaprasftikfzRAMSca tilAn sarpiSca vE jale । SaktupiRqAn guqapiRqAn dadyAcca daSasaNKyayA ॥ tato gaNgAtawe ramye hemnA rUpyeRa vA taTA । gaNgAyAH pratimAM kftvA vakzyamARasvarUpiRIm ॥ saMsTApya pUjayeddevIM tadalABe mfdApi vA । aTa tatrApyaSaktaScet liKet pizwena vE Buvi ॥ vakzyamARena mantreRa kuryyAt pUjAM viSezataH । nArAyaRaM maheSaYca brahmARaM BAskaraM taTA ॥ BagIraTaYca nfpatiM himavantaM nageSvaram । ganDapuzpAdiBiH samyak yaTASakti prapUjayet ॥ daSaprasTAn tilAn dadyAt daSavipreBya eva ca । daSaprasTAn yavAn dadyAt daSasaNKyagavIstaTA ॥’ prasTAH zoqaSapalAni । palantu । muzwimAtraM pasvaM smftamiti mahArRave uktam । ‘matsyakacCapamaRqUkamakarAdijalecarAn । kArayitvA yaTASakti svarRena rajatena vA ॥ tadalABe pizwamayAnaByarccya kusumAdiBiH । gaNgAyAM prakzipedAjyadIpAMScEva pravAhayet ॥ puzpAdyEH pUjayed gaNgAM mantreRAnena BaktitaH । o~ namaH SivAyE nArAyaRyE daSaharAyE gaNgAyE namo namaH । iti mantrantu yo martyo dine tasmin divAniSam । japet paYcasahasrARi daSaDarmmaPalaM laBet ॥’ * ॥ kASIKaRqe tvanyo mantra uktaH । ‘namaH SivAyE praTamaM nArAyaRyE padaM tataH । daSaharAyE padamiti gaNgAyE mantra eza vE ॥ svAhAntaH praRavAdiSca BavedyiMSAkzaro manuH । pUjA dAnaM japo homastenEva manunA smftaH ॥’ iti atra gaNgAstotrapAWamapi daSavAraM kuryyAt । taduktaM Bavizye । ‘tasyAM daSamyAmetacca stotraM gaNgAjale sTitaH । yaH paWet daSakftvastu daridro vApi vAkzamaH ॥ so'pi tatPalamApnoti gaNgAM saMpUjya yatnataH .’ iti stotraYca pratipadAdidaSamIparyyantadinavfdDisaMNKyayA paWanIyamiti SizwAH ॥ atra sarvvo'pi vistaraH stotrAdiSca BawwakftatrisTalIsetoravaDeyaH । vistaraBItestu na liKyate ॥ * ॥ evaM kurvvataH PalamuktaM kASIKaRqe । ‘evaM kftvA viDAnena vittaSAWyavivarjjitaH । upavAsI vakzyamARErdaSapApEH pramucyate ॥ sarvvAn kAmAnavApnoti pretya brahmaRi lIyate ॥’ iti । asyAM setubanDarAmeSvarasya pratizWAdinatvAt viSezeRa pUjA kAryyA । taduktaM skAnde setumAhAtmye । ‘jyEzWe mAsi site pakze daSamyAM buDahastayoH । garAnande vyatIpAte kanyAcandre vfze ravO ॥ daSayoge setumaDye liNgarUpaDaraM haram । rAmo vE sTApayAmAsa SivaliNgamanuttamamiti ॥” iti nirRayasinDudvitIyaparicCede saMvatsarakftyam ॥ kiYca । “adya haste tu nakzatre daSamyAM jyEzWake site । daSapApaharAyAYca adattAdAnakalmazam ॥ virudDAcaraRaM hiMsA paradAropasevanam । pAruzyAnftapESunyamasambadDaYca BAzaRam ॥ paradravyABiDyAnaYca manasAnizwacintanam । etaddaSAGaGAtAya gaNgAsnAnaM karomyaham ॥” iti gAruqe 215 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ aparaYca । “jyEzWe daSaharAyAntu vizRorizwiM nfpa ! SfRu । vena vA viDinA kAryyA sezwirvvizRornfpEH sadA ॥ pratyabdaM pArTivaH kuryyAt pratimAM kAYcanIM hareH । anyatejomayIM vApi dAravIM vA SilAmayIm ॥ pratizWAM viDivattasyAH kuryyAdbipraH purohitaH । tAM saMsTApya surAgAre svayaM vA yatnataH kfte ॥ vAsudevasya vIjena pUrvvoktaviDinA taTA । sarvvopacArErBaktyA tu vAsudevaM prapUjayet ॥ pUjAnte saMskfte vahnO kuRqamaDye sTito dvijaH । AjyEH sahasraM juhuyAdAhutInAM hareH kfte ॥ saMpUjya vAmudevantu homaM kftvA tato dvijaH । nfpasyAnumate tAntu pratimAM maRqalaM nayet ॥ pratimAyAH kapolO dvO spfzwvA dakziRapARinA । prARapratizWAM kurvvIta tasyAM devasya vE hareH ॥ kftAyAntu pratizWAyAM prARAnAM nfpasattama ! । vizRoH prARAstAM pratimAmAyAnti niyataM svayam ॥ prARezvaTAgatezu syAddevatvaM niyataM Bavet । akftAyAM pratizwAyAM prARAnAM pratimAsu ca । yaTA pUrvvaM taTA BAvaH svarRAdInAM na vizRutA ॥ anyezAmapi devAnAM pratimAsvapi pArTiva ! । prARapratizwA karttavyA tasyA devatvasidDaye ॥ suvarRastu suvarRaM syAt SilA dAru taTA SilA । anyaTa SudDarUpaM syAt prARasTAnamfte sadA ॥ vAsudevasya vIjena tadbizRorityanena ca । taTEvANgANgimantrAByAM pratizWAmAcaredDareH ॥ taTEva hfdaye'NguzwaM dattvA SaSvacca mantravit । eBirmmantrEH pratizWAntu hfdaye'pi samAcaret ॥ asmE prARAH pratizWantu asmE prARAH kzarantu ca । asmE devatvasaNKyAyE svAheti yajuruccaran ॥ aNgamantrEraNgimantrErvvEdikErityanena ca । prARapratizWAM sarvvatra pratimAsu samAcaret ॥ pratimApUjane kuryyAdAtmanyapi ca mantravit । prARapratizWAM praTamaM pUjABAgaviSudDaye ॥ asmit prARapratizWAntu pratimApUjanAdfte । na kvacittu buDaH kuryyAt kftvA mftyumavApnuyAt ॥ vizRorizwimimAM kftvA daSamyAM pArTivottamaH । tasyAmeva tu pUrRAyAM pratimAM sTApayettataH ॥ evaM daSaharAyAntu kftvezwiM pArTivo hareH । sarvvAn kAmAnavApnoti nirvviGno'pi sa jAyate ॥” iti kAlikApurARe 89 aDyAyaH ॥

v: pu॰ karma॰ janmavarzAdilagnAMSaviSezAnItezu tanvAdidvAdaSaBAvezu daSame BAve । tadAnayanaprakAro yaTA । “pUrvaM nataM syAddinarAtriKaRqaM divAniSorizwaGawIvihInam । divAniSorizwaGawIzu SudDaM dyurAtriKaRqaM tvaparaM nataM syAt । tatkAle sAyanArkasya BuktaBogyAMSasaMguRAt । svodayAt KAgnilabDaM yat BuktaM BogyaM ravestyajet । izwanAqIpaleByaSca gatagamyAnnijodayAt । SezaM KatryAhataM BuktamaSudDena lavAdikam । aSudDaM SudDaBe hInayuk tanurvyayanAMSakam । evaM laNkodayErBuktaBogyaM SoDyaM palIkftAt । pUrvapaScAnnatAdanyat prAgvattaddaSamaM Bavet” । jAtakopayopayogitadBAve SuBASuBaM sarvArTaci॰ uktaM yaTA “daSamAt pravfttimAjYAM kIrttiM vfzwiM pravAsapUrttAdIn । mAnaM karmAjIvaM jAnusTAnaM ca nirdiSedDImAn । karmADipe hInabale sapApe karmAdivEkalyamuSanti tajjYAH । karmeSavAgISaSaSANkaputrAvIryAnvitA yajYakarA Bavanti । SuBagrahErdfzwisamanvitAste vIryyAnvitA yajYaviSezamAhuH । duHsTAH SaSANkAtmajajIvaSukrAH pApekzitAH karmavinASamAhuH । nASasTitAstatra tadaMSanATAstadyuktarASeraDipASca nASam । rAhO ca mAne yadi vA dineSe BAgIraTI snAnamuSanti tajjAH । mAne ca mIne yadi vA sasOmye BOmAnvite vA BavitA ca muktiH । jalarkzage pUrRaSaSANkajIve grAnasTite gANgajalAdipUtaH । mAne gurO Sukrayute ca kendre KoccasTite tAdfSatoyapUtaH । mAne Dane Sukrayute sajIve kendroccage tAdfSatoyapUtaH । buDe vyaye vA yadi vA tadISe svoccAnvite tAdfSapuzpaBAk syAt । candre tftIye jalarASiyukte sOmyAnvite tAdfSapuzpaBAk syAt । SuBeSvare kendrayute jalarkze sOmyekzite tAdfSatoyapUtaH । buDe sajIve yadi vA saBOme prAkArakfnmaRqapagopurAdIn । mAnasTite tadgfhanATayukte karoti jIrRodDaraRAdi tatra । karoti kUpAditawAgaBUmiM karmeSvare gopuraBAgayukte । mfdvaMSake vA SuBadfzwiyuktaBAgyeSvareRApi nirIkzite vA । candrAtmaje karmagate tadISe BAgyasTite pApavivarjite'smin । sOmyekzite SoBanaBAvayukte yajYasya karttA sa Bavet tadAnIm । karmADipe'smin yadi somaputre svoccasTite vA yadi DarmarASO । vivarjitaH syAcCiKirAhupApEryajYasya karttA sa BavettadAnIm । karmADipe svoccagate sapApe nIcAMSage nASagate'pi tasmin । viGno Bavatyeva maKasya tasya krUrAdizazWAMSagate'pi cEvam । tuNgasTite somasute tadISe svoccAnvite somasutena dfzwe । SuBekzite vA sabuDe svarASO yajYasya karttA sa BavettadAnIm । AjYAsTAnADipe sOmye SuBadfzwiyute'pi vA । SoBanAMSagate vApi jAtastvAjYADipo Bavet । AjYAsTAnagate sUrye BUmiputre'Ta vA yute । kendrAnvite tadISe'pi krUrAmAjYAM karoti saH । AjYADipe mandayute ranDranATena saMyute । krUrAMSe kendrarASO vA krUrAmAjYAM karoti saH । mAnADipe kendrayute SuBayuktekzite'pi vA । krUrazazWAMSasaMyukte sOmyAmAjYAM karoti saH । rAhumandayute mAne ranDre rAhO Dvaje'pi vA । nIcasTe DarmaBAveSe krUrAmAjYAM karoti saH । SaSANke karkisaMyukte guruSukranirIkzite । pArAvatAdiBAgasTe satkIrttisahito Bavet । tadISe SuBasaMyukte SuBamaDyagate'pi vA । SuBagrahARAsaMSe vA satkIrttirahito Bavet । kAntisTAnADipe sOmye svoccamitrasvavargage । sOmyazazWAMSake vApi satkIrttisahito Bavet । tadISe devalokasTe siMhAMSe SuBanAyake । balapUrRe vilagneSe satkIrttisahito Bavet । pApagrahARAM sambanDe mAnanATe balakzaye । krUrazazWAMSasaMyukte satkIrttisahito Bavet । apakIrttiyuto jAtaH karmasTe ca ravO SanO । pApAMSake pApadfzwe pApamaDyagate'pi tat । SuBagrahARAM sambanDe mAnatannAyake'pi vA । svocce vA svagfhe vApi jAto mAnI dfQavrataH । iNgitajYo'pi mAnI syAnmAne jIve'Ta vA SuBe । tadISe SuBasambadDe SuBamaDyagate'pi vA । pApe mAne pApadfzwe tadISe nIcarASige । pAparASyaMSake vApi mAnahIno BavennaraH । mAnADipe carAMSasTe saYcArasahito Bavet । sTirAMSasTEryyamuddizwaM mfgayAtra dvidehage । zazWeSe karmarASisTe karmeSe mandasaMyute । kendratrikoRage vApi dAsI dAsAn vinirdiSet । karmADipasTAMSapatO SanisambanDasaMyute । zazWADipasya sambanDe bahudAsAn vinirdiSet । SuBagraheRa saMdfzwe karmarASO tadISvare । BAnuputreRa vA yukte bahudAmAn vinirdiSet । karmanATena vA BuktipraSne pUrtiM vinirdiSet । tatra pApasamAyoge jAnudOrvalyamAdiSet” । varzalagnAt daSamaBAvaPalAdikaM nIla॰ tA॰ uktaM yaTA “sabale'vdapatO KasTe rAjyArTasuKakIrttayaH । sTAnAntarAptiranyasmin kendre gfhasuKAptayaH । itTaM valI raviH KasTaH pUrvArjitapadAptikft । ekAdaSe'smin saKyaM syAnnfpAmAtyaguRottamEH । ravisTAnenTihA lagne sve vA rAjyAptisOKyadA । nIce'rke pApasaMyukte BUpAdbanDavaDa diSet । siMhe ravirbalI KasTaH sTAnalABanfpASraya॰ । sTAnAntarADikArAptiH induH sArapade balI । KeSalagneSavarzeSetTaSAlo rAjyadAyakaH । varzeSe rAjyasahame'rketTaRAle mahAnnfpaH । SanisTAne kujaH paSyan muTahAM pApakfnmataH । nfpaBItiM vittanASaM dadyAddaSamago yadi । IdfSe trinavasTe'smin dagDe nazwe'GasaYcayaH । mando'vdapo'DikArI triDarmage DarmavfdDidaH । tasmin dagDe'pi nazwe ca pApakfdDarmanindakaH । IdfSIdfkPalaM sUryye gurAvitTaM nayArTaBAk । tatrasTA susTahA puRyAgamapApaM KalASrayAt । sUtO KeSe ravO KasTe varzemuTaSilaM yadi । lagnADipena rAjyAptiruktA vIryyAnumAnataH । GarmakarmADipO dagDO DarmarAjyakzayAvahO” ।

a: दशन् — num. a. (pl.) Ten; स भूमिं विश्वतो वृत्वा अत्यतिष्ठद्दशांगुलं Rv. 10. 90. 1. --Comp. --अंगुल a. ten fingers long. --(लं) a water-melon. --अधिपतिः a commander of ten men. --अर्ध a. five. --(र्धं) five. --(र्धः) an epithet of Buddha. --अर्हः {1} an epithet of Kṛṣṇa or Viṣṇu. {2} Buddha. --अवताराः m. pl. the ten incarnations of Viṣṇu; see under अवतार. --अवर a. consisting of at least ten. --अश्वः the moon. --आननः, --आस्यः epithets of Rāvaṇa; R. 10. 75. --आमयः an epithet of Rudra. --ईशः a superintendent of 10 villages. --एकादशिक a. who lends 10 and receives 11 in return; i. e. who lends money at ten per cent. --कंठः, --कंधरः epithets of Rāvaṇa; सप्तलोकैकवीरस्य दशकंठकुलद्बिषः U. 4. 27. ˚अरिः, ˚जित् m., रिपुः epithets of Rāma; R. 8. 29. --कर्मन् n. the ten ceremonies prescribed to the three twice-born classes. --कुमारचरितं a prose work by Daṇḍin. --गुण a. ten-fold, ten times larger. --ग्रामपतिः, --ग्रामिकः, --ग्रामिन् m. --पः a superintendent of ten villages. --ग्रामी a collection or corporation of ten villages. --ग्रीवः = दशकंठ q. v. --पारमिताध्वरः ‘possessing the ten perfections,’ an epithet of Buddha. --पुरं N. of an ancient city, capital of king Rantideva; Me. 47. --बंधः a tenth part. --बलः, --भूमिगः epithets of Buddha. --बाहुः an epithet of Śiva. --भुजा, --महाविद्या N. of Durgā. --मालिकाः pl. {1} N. of a country. {2} the people or rulers of this country. --मास्य a. {1} ten months old. {2} ten months in the womb (as a child before birth). --मुखः an epithet of Rāvaṇa. ˚रिपुः an epithet of Rāma; R. 14. 87. --मूलं a tonic medicine prepared from the roots of ten plants. --रथः N. of a celebrated king of Ayodhyā, son of Aja, and father of Rāma and his three brothers. [He had three wives Kauśalyā, Sumitrā, and Kaikeyī, but was for several years without issue. He was therefore recommended by Vasiṣṭha to perform a sacrifice which he successfully did with the assistance of Ṛṣyaśṛṅga. On the completion of this sacrifice Kausalyā bore to him Rāma, Sumitrā Lakṣmaṇa and Śatrughna, and Kaikeyī Bharata. Daśaratha was extremely fond of his sons, but Rāma was his greatest favourite -- ‘his life, his very soul’. Thus when Kaikeyī at the instigation of Manthara demanded the fulfilment of the two boons he had previously promised to her, the king tried to dissuade her mind from her wicked resolve by threats, and, failing these, by the most servile supplications. But Kaikeyī remained inexorable, and the poor monarch was obliged to send his beloved son into exile. He soon afterwards died of a broken heart]. --रश्मिशतः the sun; R. 8. 29. --रात्रं a period of ten nights. --(त्रः) a particular sacrifice lasting for ten days. --रूपभृत् m. an epithet of Viṣṇu. --लक्षणकः religion; cf. धृतिः क्षमा दमोऽस्तेयं शौचमिंद्रियनिग्रहः . धीविंद्या सत्यमक्रोधो दशकं धर्मलक्षणम् ... --वक्त्रः, --वदनः see दशमुख. --वाजिन् m. the moon. --वार्षिक a. happening after, or lasting for, ten years. --विध a. of ten kinds. --शतं {1} a thousand. {2} one hundred and ten. ˚रश्मिः the sun. ˚अक्षः, ˚नयनः Indra. --शती a thousand. --स (सा) हस्रं ten thousand. --हरा {1} an epithet of the Ganges. {2} a festival in honour of the Ganges held on the 10th day of Jyeṣṭha. {3} a festival in honour of Durgā held on the tenth of Āśvina.
